closedFindings.finding: Luna transport needed an explicit per-client ban on hidden retry and redirects, with body reads included in the actual call budget.
closedFindings.resolution: OkHttp client clone disables connection retry and redirects, applies remaining call timeout at execution, bounds full-body read and cancels/closes failed calls.
closedFindings.evidence: LunaTransportNoReplayContractTest observes one physical connection/request and cancellation of an unfinished response; original JDK raw tests were GREEN and no duplicate was observed.

closedFindings.finding: Publication deadline expiry after writes could leave worker retries or a rollback-only enclosing matching transaction.
closedFindings.resolution: Typed AnalysisDeadlineExceededException rolls back the atomic bounded publication; processors publish ANALYSIS_DELAYED in a fresh transaction, and bounded matching has no enclosing transaction.
closedFindings.evidence: BoundedPublicationRollbackPostgresTest covers structured rows, matching places/candidates, worker ACK and preserved prior winner.

closedFindings.finding: Durable admission could consume the provider budget after the timeout had already been chosen.
closedFindings.resolution: Recompute remaining time after admission; record admitted timeout without starting HTTP when exhausted.
closedFindings.evidence: BoundedAdmissionBudgetContractTest asserts Luna 1s at t56, no HTTP at t58 and TIMEOUT admission, and Gemini to Luna reserve behavior at t43.

closedFindings.finding: A rejected second Gemini admission after reserve exhaustion discarded eligible fallback.
closedFindings.resolution: Only a prior retryable Gemini failure plus exhausted Gemini window can continue toward Luna; fresh ownership/current-run checks still apply.
closedFindings.evidence: RejectedAdmissionFallbackContractTest real RED contained one assertion failure; t43 receives Luna14 while early and stale rejections never fallback.

closedFindings.finding: Claim lock wait could create a new deadline after acquiring the room lock.
closedFindings.resolution: Capture original admission start/deadline before lock wait and expire when the original budget is exhausted.
closedFindings.evidence: AnalysisInvocationAdmissionDeadlinePostgresTest uses actual PostgreSQL blocking proof, preserves original deadline and forbids invocation/provider calls after exhaustion.

reviewedBoundaries: Shared provider schema, common structural validator and deterministic postprocessing; strict required nullable rejection_code.
Typed status/network/timeouts; only retryable infrastructure failures enter bounded full-jitter retries or fallback; permanent/invalid responses remain distinct.
Physical provider attempt limits and deadline reserve, cancellation around transport, actual remaining-time rechecks after durable admission.
Durable database owner, exact version, active run and open revision fences; persisted counters; atomic winner plus matching; conservative expiry recovery after crash.
Search scope is applied after valid provider conditions are preserved; outside AVAILABLE-only cannot become unrestricted availability.

capturedFixture.claim: Actual parent-supplied saved response, replayed locally through shared validation and matching; no response was fabricated or generated in this implementation session.

limitations: Captured-response replay establishes preservation and deterministic matching. It does not establish fresh model language quality; the parent owns the separately completed paid evaluation.
All implementation verification here is free fixtures, mocks, raw loopback TCP and PostgreSQL. Paid provider calls in this implementation session: zero.
Cancellation/deadline tests cover local transport and bounded publication. They do not guarantee a remote provider did not perform work before cancellation.
Durable recovery deliberately expires interrupted invocations without replaying an admitted physical call; no model-side exactly-once promise is made.
Original transport raw tests were GREEN on JDK; the migration followed an independently reviewed policy gap, not an invented duplicate-request RED.
Original review RED had 14 tests and 11 failures (6 reviewer publication/admission, 5 lifecycle). Raw transport 2 were GREEN; lifecycle XML was not archived, with honest log-only provenance retained.
Draft PR, remote HEAD CI, merge and deployment are outside this reviewer work item and remain owned by the parent.
